_help: Solar-system view on the Skills page. The sun is 'core'; every category in skills.json becomes a planet and its skills become moons. 'planetOrbits' says which planets (by category number, 1 = first card) go on the inner and outer orbit and how many seconds one lap takes. 'notes' is the tooltip for each skill (moon).

notes.Python: Automated pulling table references and T-SQL out of hundreds of SSRS .rdl files.
notes.T-SQL: Converted report queries and stored procedures from SQL Server to Databricks SQL.
notes.DAX: Measures and data models behind KPI tracking in Power BI.
notes.Power BI: Portfolio at Risk, Agent Productivity, Claims and Insurance dashboards.
notes.Databricks: Certified Data Engineer Associate; target platform of the SSRS migration.
notes.DBT: Rebuilt T-SQL stored procedures as DBT models on Databricks.
notes.Azure DevOps: CI/CD pipelines that deploy DBT models and Databricks notebooks.
notes.SSRS: Migrated 200–400 SSRS reports from SQL Server to Databricks.
notes.SQL Server: Source system for the migration, and where her data journey started.
notes.ODBC: Repointed reports to Databricks over ODBC connections.
notes.Simba Spark Driver: The ODBC driver used to connect the reports to Databricks.
notes.PAT Authentication: Databricks personal access tokens for secure report connections.
notes.ETL Transformations: Restructured raw data into clean models for downstream reports.
notes.CI/CD Pipelines: Automated, version-controlled deployments through Azure DevOps.
notes.Version Control: Git repositories in Azure DevOps for models and notebooks.
notes.Pipeline Management: Scheduling Databricks jobs, provisioned with Terraform.
